segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
My name is Kathryn and today we're talking about going out for a drink.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们正在谈论出去喝一杯。

segments.en: We're going to a bar and we're going to order cocktails.
segments.zh: 我们要去酒吧，我们要点鸡尾酒。

segments.en: So we're going to learn all about the different types of cocktails and a little bit more language that you can use at a bar.
segments.zh: 因此，我们将了解所有不同类型的鸡尾酒以及您可以在酒吧使用的更多语言。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的对话。

segments.en: We'll be back in a moment.

segments.zh: 请给我一杯“都市佳人”鸡尾酒。

segments.en: Dude, you can't order a Cosmo.
Order something with a little more kick to it.
I'll have a Sex on the Beach.
segments.zh: 那我要一杯“性感海滩”鸡尾酒。

segments.en: You have got to be kidding me.
Especially when served with a pineapple or a coconut.
segments.zh: 尤其是与菠萝或椰子一起食用时。

segments.en: I'll have a Scotch on the Rocks and my friend here will have a Manhattan.
segments.zh: 我要一杯加冰苏格兰威士忌，我朋友要一杯“曼哈顿”鸡尾酒。

segments.en: Now, this is a real drink.
segments.zh: 现在，这是一种真正的饮料。

segments.en: This is going to get me wasted.
So now, let's take a look at some of those drinks on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在，让我们来看看一些关于语言外卖的饮料。

segments.en: So in Language Takeaway today, we're going to focus on the names of drinks.
segments.zh: 因此，在今天的语言外卖中，我们将专注于饮料的名称。

segments.en: So we heard four of them in today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以我们在今天的对话中听到了其中的四个。

segments.en: What was that first one, Marco?
The first one was a Cosmo or also called a Cosmopolitan.
segments.zh: 第一个是 Cosmo 或也称为 Cosmopolitan。

segments.en: So this is something if you watch the TV show Sex in the City, you will have heard before because the girls always order Cosmos.
segments.zh: 所以如果你在城市里看电视节目《性爱》，你会听说过，因为女孩们总是点宇宙。

segments.en: Now, a Cosmopolitan is served in a martini glass, right?
segments.zh: 现在，一个国际化的马提尼酒杯供应，对吧？

segments.en: It kind of looks like a triangle.
segments.zh: 它看起来像一个三角形。

segments.en: And it's very easy to spill.
So what does a Cosmo have?
Because obviously, a cocktail is a combination of different liquors or alcohol with maybe juices and stuff like that.
segments.zh: 因为显然，鸡尾酒是不同的酒或酒精与可能的果汁和类似的东西的组合。

segments.en: So what does a Cosmo have?
Cosmo is a vodka drink, I believe, and it's served in a martini glass.
segments.zh: Cosmo 是一种伏特加饮料，我相信它是装在马提尼酒杯中的。

segments.en: But it's generally considered a drink for ladies, for women.
segments.zh: 但它通常被认为是女士和女性的饮料。

segments.en: Probably because it's a weaker drink, but also because it's popular in the media and in movies and stuff as a women's drink.
segments.zh: 可能是因为它是一种较弱的饮料，但也因为它在媒体和电影和女性饮料中很受欢迎。

segments.en: So that's how it got that reputation.
segments.zh: 所以这就是它获得这种声誉的原因。

segments.en: So that's what a Cosmo is.
And now we move on to another very popular drink, a little bit more tropical.
segments.zh: 现在我们转向另一种非常受欢迎的饮料，有点热带。

segments.en: I think everyone always has it when the Caribbean or when they're on vacation at the beach.
segments.zh: 我认为每个人在加勒比海或在海滩度假时总是拥有它。

segments.en: It's called a Sex on the Beach.
segments.zh: 它被称为海滩上的性爱。

segments.en: This name might make you laugh because Sex on the Beach, it's very descriptive, but it's actually a very common drink.
segments.zh: 这个名字可能会让你发笑，因为在海滩上做爱，它非常具有描述性，但它实际上是一种非常常见的饮料。

segments.en: And in the dialogue, he talks about how he likes to have this drink served in a pineapple or a coconut.
segments.zh: 在对话中，他谈到了他喜欢如何将这种饮料放在菠萝或椰子中。

segments.en: So that means it's very fruity.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着它非常果味。

segments.en: And I think it's a rum drink, right?
segments.zh: 我认为这是朗姆酒饮料，对吧？

segments.en: And it usually has either coconut juice in it or maybe some pineapple juice.
segments.zh: 它通常有椰子汁或一些菠萝汁。

segments.en: I think they add a little bit of vanilla or even ice cream or milk or something like that.
segments.zh: 我认为他们添加了一点香草甚至冰淇淋或牛奶或类似的东西。

segments.en: It's kind of like a milkshake with liquor.
I don't know that I've ever had one, but this is the part of the dialogue where his friend says, come on, you need to buy something that's more manly.
segments.zh: 我不知道我曾经有过一个，但这是他朋友说，来吧，你需要买一些更有男子气概的东西的对话部分。

segments.en: He orders a Scotch on the rocks instead.
segments.zh: 他在岩石上点了一个苏格兰威士忌。

segments.en: So a Scotch is a type of liquor.
segments.zh: 所以苏格兰威士忌是一种酒。

segments.en: Scotch whiskey comes from Scotland and it's a whiskey drink.
segments.zh: 苏格兰威士忌来自苏格兰，这是一种威士忌饮料。

segments.en: And basically, Scotch on the rocks means Scotch poured over ice.
segments.zh: 基本上，岩石上的苏格兰威士忌意味着苏格兰威士忌倒在冰上。

segments.en: So, in this case, rocks means ice.
segments.zh: 所以，在这种情况下，岩石意味着冰。

segments.en: Do you want that on the rocks?
Do you want that on ice?
So you don't say, I want whiskey with ice or you don't say, I want Scotch with ice.
segments.zh: 所以你不说，我想要冰威士忌，或者你不说，我想要冰苏格兰威士忌。

segments.en: You can just say on the rocks.

segments.zh: 岩石上的苏格兰威士忌。

segments.en: So it may be if you're ordering a rum drink and you don't want it mixed with anything, you can say rum on the rocks.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您要订购朗姆酒饮料并且您不希望它与任何东西混合，您可以说朗姆酒在岩石上。

segments.en: And not only are we ordering a Scotch on the rocks, but we're also ordering a Manhattan.
segments.zh: 我们不仅在岩石上点了一杯苏格兰威士忌，而且我们还订购了曼哈顿。

segments.en: So what does a Manhattan have?
A Manhattan is a very strong cocktail.
segments.zh: 曼哈顿是一种非常浓郁的鸡尾酒。

segments.en: It has bourbon, which is a kind of whiskey.
segments.zh: 它有波本威士忌，这是一种威士忌。

segments.en: It has vermouth, which is also a very strong ingredient.
segments.zh: 它有苦艾酒，这也是一种非常强烈的成分。

segments.en: Bitters is another kind of ingredient that is often used in cocktails to make things bitter.
segments.zh: 苦味是另一种经常用于鸡尾酒的成分，使事情变得苦涩。

segments.en: So it's not a sweet drink.
Although they sometimes put a little bit of lemon or orange rind in the drink and that's the skin of the orange.
segments.zh: 虽然他们有时会在饮料中加入一点柠檬或橙皮，这就是橙子的皮肤。

segments.en: So both these drinks are pretty strong.
segments.zh: 所以这两种饮料都很浓。

segments.en: All the ones that we've seen, the Cosmo, the Sex on the Beach, they're all called cocktails.
segments.zh: 我们见过的所有，Cosmo，海滩上的性爱，它们都被称为鸡尾酒。

segments.en: And a cocktail has the characteristic that it usually has alcohol, right?
segments.zh: 鸡尾酒有它通常有酒精的特点，对吧？

segments.en: So cocktail is a mix of different ingredients, but it's an alcohol-based drink.
segments.zh: 所以鸡尾酒是不同成分的混合物，但它是一种酒精饮料。

segments.en: You can also get non-alcoholic cocktails.
segments.zh: 您还可以获得非酒精鸡尾酒。

segments.en: So why don't we take a break?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不休息一下呢？

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 让我们再次聆听对话，我们将在 Fluency Builder 中回来。

segments.en: Dude, you can't order a Cosmo.
Order something with a little more kick to it.
I'll have a Sex on the Beach.
segments.zh: 那我要一杯“性感海滩”鸡尾酒。

segments.en: You have got to be kidding me.
Especially when served with a pineapple or a coconut.
segments.zh: 尤其是与菠萝或椰子一起食用时。

segments.en: I'll have a Scotch on the Rocks and my friend here will have a Manhattan.
segments.zh: 我要一杯加冰苏格兰威士忌，我朋友要一杯“曼哈顿”鸡尾酒。

segments.en: Now, this is a real drink.
segments.zh: 现在，这是一种真正的饮料。

segments.en: This is going to get me wasted.
So now, let's talk a little bit more about these drinks on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在，让我们在 Fluency Builder 上多谈谈这些饮料。

segments.en: So Marco, there are many different ways to talk about drinks but the most important ones that we often discuss, especially with cocktails, is weak drinks versus strong drinks.
segments.zh: 所以马可，有很多不同的方式来谈论饮料，但我们经常讨论的最重要的方式，尤其是鸡尾酒，是弱饮料而不是强饮料。

segments.en: Usually, the Cosmo or maybe the Sex on the Beach, it's considered to be a weak drink.
segments.zh: 通常，Cosmo 或者可能是海滩上的性爱，它被认为是一种弱饮料。

segments.en: So it's not very strong because there's less alcohol.
segments.zh: 所以它不是很强，因为酒精少。

segments.en: Like a Cosmo has fruit juice, like cranberry juice, and the Sex on the Beach is very fruity so it makes it less alcoholy.
segments.zh: 就像 Cosmo 有果汁，就像蔓越莓汁一样，海滩上的性爱非常果味，所以它减少了酒精。

segments.en: And actually, those two also have one type of alcohol.
segments.zh: 实际上，这两个也有一种酒精。

segments.en: Whereas, maybe a Manhattan has all this mix of bourbon and other drinks as well so it'll be a strong alcoholic drink.
segments.zh: 然而，也许曼哈顿有所有这些波旁威士忌和其他饮料的混合物，所以它会是一种浓烈的酒精饮料。

segments.en: And Scotch on the Rocks is also very strong because it's just scotch.
segments.zh: 岩石上的苏格兰威士忌也很强壮，因为它只是苏格兰威士忌。

segments.en: You're not mixing it with anything.
segments.zh: 你没有把它和任何东西混合在一起。

segments.en: There's just some ice and some scotch.
segments.zh: 只有一些冰和一些苏格兰威士忌。
所以这是一杯浓烈的饮料。

segments.en: So obviously, his friend was saying that all those drinks are too weak.
segments.zh: 很明显，他的朋友说所有这些饮料都太弱了。

segments.en: He should order something with a little more kick to it.
segments.zh: 他应该订购一些更有趣的东西。

segments.en: So in this context, kick means strength.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，踢意味着力量。

segments.en: He wants a drink that's not weak, that's strong.
segments.zh: 他想要一种不弱的饮料，那是强壮的。

segments.en: So a strong drink has more kick than a weak drink.
segments.zh: 所以强酒比弱饮料更有活力。

segments.en: So can we use this with food or with other situations?
segments.zh: 那么我们可以将其与食物或其他情况一起使用吗？

segments.en: You can, but with food, it usually means spice.
segments.zh: 你可以，但有食物，它通常意味着香料。

segments.en: So Indian food tends to have a lot of kick to it.
segments.zh: 所以印度食物往往有很多刺激。

segments.en: If this rice has a kick to it, it means it's a little spicy.
segments.zh: 如果这米饭有味道，那就意味着它有点辣。

segments.en: So just think about kick as meaning that something is strong or has a strong flavor.
segments.zh: 因此，只需将 kick 视为意味着某物很强或具有强烈的味道。

segments.en: Now, when they were ordering, they didn't pay immediately because she said, put it on my tab.
segments.zh: 现在，当他们订购时，他们没有立即付款，因为她说，把它放在我的标签上。

segments.en: So to put something on a tab, this is really important when you're going to a bar or a restaurant and you want to order drinks.
segments.zh: 因此，要将某些东西放在标签上时，当您要去酒吧或餐厅并想点饮料时，这非常重要。

segments.en: A tab is a bill that you don't pay immediately.
segments.zh: 标签是您不会立即支付的账单。

segments.en: The bartender will write down all of the drinks that you have and all of their prices and you pay when you leave.
segments.zh: 酒保会写下你所有的饮料和他们所有的价格，你在离开时支付。

segments.en: So if you put something on your tab, you'll pay it later or when you leave.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您在标签上放了一些东西，您将在以后或离开时付款。

segments.en: So normally at a bar in America, you say, I want to start a tab.
segments.zh: 所以通常在美国的一家酒吧，你说，我想开一个标签。

segments.en: That means I want to start a bill and you give the bartender your credit card and he will keep your credit card until you leave.
segments.zh: 这意味着我想开一张账单，你把信用卡给调酒师，他会把你的信用卡保留在你离开之前。

segments.en: So he keeps your credit card until you leave because obviously maybe you start a tab and then you want to leave and you don't want to pay then it's a problem.
segments.zh: 所以他会保留你的信用卡直到你离开，因为显然你可能开始一个标签，然后你想离开，你不想付款，那是一个问题。

segments.en: Or people get a little bit drunk and they forget they have to pay.
segments.zh: 或者人们有点醉了，他们忘记了他们必须付钱。

segments.en: So bartenders now keep your credit card so that even if you forget to pay, they can charge you.
segments.zh: 因此，调酒师现在保留您的信用卡，以便即使您忘记付款，他们也可以向您收费。

segments.en: And now for our last phrase, he was a little bit concerned because this drink is so strong.
segments.zh: 现在我们的最后一句话，他有点担心，因为这种饮料太浓了。

segments.en: He said, this is going to get me wasted.
So to be wasted or to get wasted means to get very, very drunk.
segments.zh: 所以被浪费或被浪费意味着变得非常非常醉。

segments.en: So if you say I'm wasted, it means I'm very drunk.
segments.zh: 所以如果你说我被浪费了，这意味着我喝醉了。

segments.en: You could say, oh, look at those, those boys over there.
segments.zh: 你可以说，哦，看看那些，那边的那些男孩。

segments.en: They're all, you know, being drunk and sick and yeah.
segments.zh: 他们都是，你知道的，喝醉了，生病了，是的。

segments.en: So it's a very informal, very casual kind of a colloquial way of saying being drunk or being intoxicated.
segments.zh: 因此，这是一种非常随意、非常随意的口语化方式，表示醉酒或陶醉。

segments.en: So it's, it's something we often use with friends or as you know, with young people, but it's not something you want to use in your English class because it's not a good thing to be.
segments.zh: 所以，这是我们经常与朋友或你知道的年轻人一起使用的东西，但这不是你想在英语课上使用的东西，因为这不是一件好事。

segments.en: It's not a good thing to be wasted.
So now let's take a break and listen to our dialogue one last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们休息一下，最后一次听听我们的对话，我们会回来多谈谈。

So about cocktails, liquors, what is your favorite cocktail when you go out?
segments.zh: 那么关于鸡尾酒、酒类，你出去的时候最喜欢的鸡尾酒是什么？

segments.en: I almost always order gin and tonic.
segments.zh: 我几乎总是点杜松子酒和滋补品。

segments.en: So gin is another type of liquor?
segments.zh: 那么杜松子酒是另一种酒吗？

segments.en: Gin is another type of liquor like vodka or whiskey.
segments.zh: 杜松子酒是另一种酒，如伏特加或威士忌。

segments.en: It has a very unique taste.
segments.zh: 它有一种非常独特的味道。

segments.en: And tonic is a kind of water but it has a certain flavor to it.
segments.zh: 补品是一种水，但它有一定的味道。

segments.en: It has a flavor to it.
So gin and tonic usually has some gin, some tonic water and some lime.
segments.zh: 所以杜松子酒和滋补品通常有一些杜松子酒、一些滋补水和一些酸橙。

segments.en: But the tonic water is kind of bubbly.
So you like champagne and stuff like that.
segments.zh: 所以你喜欢香槟之类的东西。

segments.en: I am a whiskey guy and so I usually order something like this scotch on the rocks.
segments.zh: 我是一个威士忌人，所以我通常会在岩石上点一些苏格兰威士忌之类的东西。

segments.en: I never like to mix it with anything else.
segments.zh: 我从不喜欢将它与其他任何东西混合。

segments.en: And especially I really don't like having sweet drinks.
segments.zh: 尤其是我真的不喜欢吃甜饮料。
所以你是一个纯粹主义者。

segments.en: It's just that when the sweet alcohol and things that are sweet, I don't really think go that well together.
segments.zh: 只是当甜酒和甜味的东西时，我真的不认为搭配得那么好。

segments.en: Although there are some sweet alcohols.
Our Italian friends will be familiar with limoncello.
segments.zh: 我们的意大利朋友会熟悉 Limoncello。

segments.en: It's a dessert liqueur which tastes like lemon.
segments.zh: 这是一种甜点利口酒，尝起来像柠檬。

segments.en: Or also Kahlua which is very sweet.
So many people like to put Kahlua in their coffee to have Irish coffee.
segments.zh: 很多人喜欢把卡鲁瓦放在他们的咖啡里喝爱尔兰咖啡。

segments.en: And actually the alcoholic world is very vast and actually many people don't drink alcohol.
segments.zh: 实际上，酗酒的世界非常广阔，实际上很多人不喝酒。

segments.en: Many people may have it occasionally.
segments.zh: 许多人可能偶尔会吃到它。

segments.en: But the other interesting thing is that usually countries have a national alcoholic drink.
segments.zh: 但另一个有趣的事情是，国家通常喝全国酒精饮料。

segments.en: So for example, the Mexican national alcoholic drink would be tequila.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，墨西哥国家酒精饮料将是龙舌兰酒。

segments.en: Or Russian or Eastern European, vodka.
segments.zh: 或俄罗斯或东欧，伏特加。

segments.en: So in your country, maybe you have a local or a national alcoholic drink we would be very interested to know about.
segments.zh: 所以在你的国家，也许你有当地或全国性的酒精饮料，我们很想知道。
